Thanks again for taking the call today. Quick recap from our side and next steps so we can move your security review forward: 

Summary from call:
- FinBank is evaluating encryption key management options for production inference (at-rest and in-transit).
- Primary asks: SOC 2 report (most recent), stance on GDPR/HIPAA, support for customer-managed keys (CMEK) and HSM-backed keys, and the ability to provide evidence for encryption controls.
- You'll be initiating the vendor security questionnaire and would like an expected timeline for SOC 2 docs & a security-engineer tech call.

What we can provide today:
- Redwood SOC 2 Type II report (attached).
- Short KMS & CMEK overview (attached) describing options: integrated KMS (Redwood-managed), AWS KMS integration (CMEK via envelope encryption), and HSM-backed key options for dedicated/private deployments.
- Confirmation: all traffic is encrypted in-transit (TLS 1.2+) and at-rest using AES-256. We support customer-managed keys for Dedicated & Private deployments; hosted customers can opt for CMEK via cloud KMS where allowed by region/contract.

Proposed next steps:
1) I'll send the SOC 2 report and the KMS overview (attached).
2) Please send the vendor security questionnaire (or attach here). We'll have a 72-hour turnaround on most questionnaire items and will escalate any items that need engineering input.
3) Camila will coordinate a technical session with our security engineer, Aditya Rao, to go over HSM/CMEK implementation details - can you share a couple of preferred times next week?

Attachments: redwood_soc2_report_2025.pdf (pdf, 2.1MB); redwood_kms_overview.pdf (pdf, 0.8MB)

Thanks and talk soon,

Marissa,

Appreciate the recap and the attachments. A couple of clarifying questions from our InfoSec team before we start the questionnaire: 

1) For hosted customers, you said CMEK is available "where allowed by region/contract" - can you confirm what that means for multi-tenant hosted instances? Do we get key separation per customer (i.e., unique CMKs) or is it envelope encryption with a platform key?
2) Do you offer HSM-backed key storage (FIPS 140-2 Level 3) for any of your deployment modes, or is that only for private/on-prem installs?
3) For in-transit encryption: can you confirm TLS versions and whether mutual TLS (mTLS) is supported for connections between our service and Redwood's control plane?

I've attached our Vendor Security Questionnaire (FinBank_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx). We'd like to have the bulk of responses back within 5 business days if possible; anything requiring engineering input is OK to flag and we can extend on a case-by-case basis.

Also, we'll likely need to align on a Data Processing Addendum (DPA) and whether Redwood supports encryption key escrow or key destruction proofs for offboarding - please flag the right legal contact if needed.

Thanks - I'll await Camila/Aditya for a technical session.

Alex Johnson
Senior InfoSec Manager | FinBank Inc.
alex.johnson@finbank.com

Alex,

Thanks for the questionnaire - we have it and will start filling it out today. Quick answers to your bullets below and what we'll confirm in the questionnaire: 

- CMEK for hosted customers: We support customer-managed keys via cloud KMS providers (AWS KMS, Google KMS, Azure Key Vault) using envelope encryption. Each customer can provision their own CMK in their cloud account for Dedicated or Private deployments. For our multi-tenant hosted offering we offer a CMEK option in select regions under specific contractual terms; that option provisions unique encryption keys scoped to the customer (not a single platform key). I'll confirm region availability in the questionnaire.
- HSM-backed keys: HSM-backed key storage (FIPS 140-2 level 2/3) is available for Private deployments and Dedicated (via HSM integrations for dedicated customers). For fully hosted multi-tenant customers, HSM-backed CMEK is limited - we can discuss options (bring-your-own-HSM via partner integration) during the tech call.
- In-transit: All API traffic is TLS 1.2+; we support TLS 1.3. mTLS is supported for Dedicated & Private deployments for control-plane and data-plane connections; hosted customers can implement mTLS via VPN or dedicated peering in most regions.

Next steps from our side:
- I'll upload the SOC 2 report to the secure drive link and return the majority of the questionnaire in ~72 hours.
- Aditya, can you join a 60-min technical session to walk through HSM/CMEK implementation details and any integration work required for FinBank? Alex, are you available Tuesday or Wednesday next week (Oct 20-21) between 10:00-15:00 PT?

Camila Reyes
